intro_uz: Mehmonxona yonidagi kichik do'konga kirdingiz. Mrs. Patel — mehribon, gapga usta do'kon egasi — kassada turibdi. Kerakli narsani qayerdan topishni so'rang, narxini bilib oling va to'lab, xalta so'rang.
setting: A cramped corner shop near the hotel, shelves up to the ceiling, evening. Mrs. Patel is behind the till with a radio playing quietly.
fallback_lines: Oh, that one is just over there, love — second aisle on your left.
Anything else you need, dear? We have fresh bread in today.
Sorry, my hearing is not what it was — say that once more?
opening_line: Evening, love! Let me know if you need help finding anything.
level5_complication: The item the player wants is sold out, so Mrs. Patel offers a more expensive alternative and the player must ask for something cheaper.
